intervention: Bounded authored subject/predicate priors anchored to clause start or explicit complement cues; no new pairwise corpus training.
selection: Use new authored validation70 and the previously frozen natural validation200. Require no top1/top5 loss versus the same model without clause priors in each set/model arm; choose highest mean MRR, ties lower strength. No valid weight means reject.
after_selection: Freeze strength, then evaluate authored heldout70, prospective public100 and old regression sets. Report feature-only and feature+Tatoeba arms separately against unchanged bundled model and previous trial.
adoption: Feature alone must retain old600, natural200, daily32, completion16 top1/top5 and new protective copula identities. Corpus model may be adopted only if the combined arm also meets those guards and prospective public top1/top5 does not regress.
release: Keep 0.6.39 and no APK unless the existing independent 1.0 gate is met. Measured authored gains do not imply real-user accuracy.
limits: Synthetic tests share constructions across splits. Existing public/regression sets were observed before and are not fresh heldout. Freeze prospective selection before candidate results are inspected.
